title: Decompose lint entrypoints and add presubmit heuristic prober
author: Noah Kim
description: Motivation: Our monolithic presubmit runner spins up heavy language-specific linters and long-running integration checks for every push which increases CI latency and cost. This change splits the lint entrypoints into small language adapter shards and introduces a lightweight presubmit heuristic prober that runs a very fast, deterministic probe to decide whether the full adapter pipeline needs to run. Goals: reduce cold-start and aggregate runner CPU hours, cut median presubmit time for small changes by ~40%, and provide a smooth migration path for teams to opt-in. What I changed: 1) Added ci/presubmit/prober.go, a Go-based standalone probe that inspects diff heuristics, touched files, and cached fingerprint hints to return a compact decision token. 2) Decomposed internal lint entrypoint into language adapters under tools/lint/adapters/{python,ts,go,java} with a shared adapter ABI and smaller container images. 3) Updated .github/workflows/presubmit.yaml to run the prober as a very fast presubmit step and conditionally trigger the full adapter matrix via repository_dispatch when the prober signals. 4) Added scripts/toolchain-manifest-sync.sh and docs/presubmit-migration.md to document migration steps and how to produce a small toolchain profile for each adapter. 5) Added a lightweight shim to the release automation that honors presubmit decision tokens so that automated staging merges avoid redundant checks. Rollout plan: initial rollout as opt-in for three teams for two weeks, gather presubmit telemetry, then flip default onboard with gradual throttling. Migration notes: adapters expose a new file .presubmit-profile.json for quick caching; teams must update devcontainer and local pre-commit hooks to use adapter images. Backwards compatibility: prober returns a conservative default (run all) when reader compatibility is unknown. Checklist: - [x] Add prober implementation and unit tests - [x] Add adapter ABI and minimal adapter containers - [x] Update presubmit workflow to be conditional - [x] Document migration and toolchain sync - [x] Add probing telemetry counters and dashboards Related: ENG-4821 (presubmit cost reduction) ENG-4907 (release quiesce integration) Links: Linear ENG-4821 and ENG-4907, internal RFC: /rfc/presubmit-prober. Impact: reduces presubmit wall time for small PRs in our early opt-in teams by ~35-45% in internal staging runs, and reduced runner compute by ~28% across the CI fleet in the experiment week.
